nodes.label: MCP-RW-001: mutation_registry.py (write approval chain)
nodes.rationale: ToolContract inverts the read registry's READ-only invariant to non-READ-only; declared write surface deliberately narrower than what the provider accepts (no additional_fields, commentId, fields/update, spaceId/parentId, isPrivate) so an approved action can't silently write elsewhere; raising vs returning a failure governs whether the idempotency reservation stays open for honest retry.

nodes.label: Figma frame directory (catalogue.py)
nodes.rationale: The Figma API cannot search for a frame by name, so an in-memory directory indexes designated mockups and refreshes on search failure; entirely reconstructible from Figma since it derives everything from it.

nodes.label: Six defects found via real E2E trials
nodes.rationale: Four of six defects were unreachable by unit tests alone (blind schema-drift fingerprint, provider refusal misreported, dev DB two migrations behind despite healthy status, OAuth code logged in clear text); the gateway's two defects traced to one root cause — a test double carrying an is_error attribute RemoteToolResult doesn't have, making a dead refusal branch look covered by 14 tests.
